label: aicent-lease-boundary
text_status: the source is a published Internet-Draft, not agreed text of any working group: draft-li-rttp-iqa-addressing-02 is Informational and published for the public record
readings: an outcome is read as the record it presents: the refusal reason and the members it carries are final, and no case asks what the implementation intended
absent_fields: an outcome lists the fields its rule reads; a field the rule reads that is missing from the outcome means the response does not carry it (an absent key is not the same as an explicit null)
field_names: outcome field names are this candidate's own representation; the source names values and rules, not a JSON binding

sources.spec: draft-li-rttp-iqa-addressing-02, posted 2026-11-01, https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-li-rttp-iqa-addressing-02, sha256 02491c5a59d1e7471be04e8e0d4933dfc22ce19f9b054ead0aa449d6b4485044 of the retrieved TXT copy; sections 6.1 (The Lease), 6.2 (Answer Modes), 6.3 (Evaluation at the Moment of Use) and the verification procedure of section 7.2 are used

cases.note: the read happens exactly at the lease instant and the deployment declared the inclusive convention; a permit is what the declared boundary owes
same boundary instant under the declared exclusive convention; refusing the answer as expired is what the declared boundary owes, and conformance material may test both boundaries

the deployment declared the inclusive convention but answers expired at the boundary instant; the declaration states which boundary they use, and a declaration that contradicts use tells the caller the opposite of the behavior

open question: the read happens at the boundary instant and no boundary is declared; both boundary readings are licensed conventions and the declaration is asked for with SHOULD, so the answer at the instant sits inside a licensed reading while the case cannot be settled until the implementation declares

the envelope frame is accepted at the boundary instant, which the verification procedure of section 7.2 requires (it rejects only when lease_expiry is earlier than the current time), and the answer is then refused under the declared exclusive convention; frame validity and reliance on the answer are different layers, and the wire floor does not decide the convention
the answer is read past its lease; the observation member keeps the as-of instant of what the answer relied on when it was issued, and the read is answered as expired
same facts, but the expired answer is answered as a permit carrying the original observation as if it were current; an answer read past its expiry is never replayed as fresh
same facts, but the lease is reinterpreted as still standing inside a locally added grace period; a verifier MUST NOT extend, renew, or reinterpret an expired lease except by obtaining a new answer

outcome.lease_note: lease treated as extended by a local grace period after issuance

cases.note: the deployment operates in live mode and the organ cannot be reached; the call is refused as authority_not_determined even though a cached answer within its lease exists, and the observation member is null because the answer relied on no observation
same facts, but the fresh cached answer is admitted as a permit; in live mode every call is expected to be refused when the organ is unreachable, regardless of the age of any cached answer
cached-lease mode with the cache within its lease and the organ unreachable, under a declared policy that demands a current observation; the call is refused with authority_not_determined
same facts under a declared policy that accepts lease-fresh evidence; the call may be admitted, with any exposure bounded by the lease itself

cached-lease mode with the cache itself past its lease and the organ unreachable; the expired cache is refused as evidence_expired, the first applicable value, and the unreachable organ adds nothing to an answer whose lease has already expired
the answer states a lease 300 seconds ahead of issuance under an operator-configured window, and the read happens inside the stated lease; a permit is what checking the stated expiry owes

same facts, but the verifier refuses the answer because it assumes the 120-second deployment default instead of checking the stated expiry; the verifier checks the stated expiry against its own clock, and the mechanism does not depend on the default value
